project.name: AVLab 23
project.description:
Between 2013 and 2014, I plan to produce approximately 30 audiovisual experiments demonstrating different relations between sound and image. 

https://vimeo.com/channels/avlab

I sincerely believe that the essence of good art is the same. Is it possible that an excellent visual layout can also produce a good sound melody? Let's see.
